en_title: Apple Announces Its First Touchscreen MacBook
subtitle: 屏幕才是主角
opus_summary: 苹果公布触屏版MacBook Pro，配备串联OLED屏幕，可选M5 Pro或M5 Max芯片，最高支持128GB内存。新机即日起开放预订，11月6日上市。

paragraphs.en: The MacBook Pro has had pretty much the same design since 2021, but today at its 'Pro and Tell' event in Cupertino, Apple has announced an all-new MacBook Pro with a touchscreen.
paragraphs.cn: MacBook Pro自2021年以来，设计几乎没有变化。不过，苹果今天在库比蒂诺举行的「Pro and Tell」活动上公布了一款全新的触屏MacBook Pro。

paragraphs.en: The new 'MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display' comes in either a 14- or 16-inch design, just like any other MacBook Pro, just with a Tandem OLED touch display with up to 128GB of RAM. But while the regular MacBook Pro 14 was updated with the M6 chip yesterday, this new touchscreen MacBook Pro will be equipped with either the M5 Pro or M5 Max, both of which will still be more powerful than Apple's new mainstream SoC.
paragraphs.cn: 这款新发布的「配备PROLED XDR显示屏的MacBook Pro」与其他MacBook Pro一样，提供14英寸和16英寸两种机型，不过配备了串联OLED（Tandem OLED）触控显示屏，内存最高可选128GB。普通版14英寸MacBook Pro昨天刚升级至M6芯片，而这款触屏MacBook Pro将搭载M5 Pro或M5 Max。尽管如此，这两款芯片的性能仍将强于苹果新推出的主流SoC。

paragraphs.en: The display is the real star of the show, though, and it should be absolutely gorgeous, coming in with up to 2,000 nits of brightness and a color gamut that covers both the P3 and Adobe RGB spectrums. Couple that with the powerful chips, and this will likely be the laptop to beat for creative professionals who are comfortable on macOS.
paragraphs.cn: 不过，真正的主角还是这块显示屏。它的最高亮度达2,000尼特，色域覆盖P3和Adobe RGB，显示效果应该会相当惊艳。再加上强劲的芯片性能，对于用惯了macOS的创意专业人士来说，这款笔记本很可能将成为其他产品需要超越的标杆。

paragraphs.en: Touchscreen laptops have been around for a while, with Microsoft famously pushing for wide adoption of touch displays with Windows 8. At the time, though, Steve Jobs took a stand against touch displays, even claiming wholeheartedly that 'Touchscreen laptops don't work' back in 2010 . But even though Apple's dad wasn't a fan of touchscreens on laptops, this isn't the first time that Apple has had a touch display on a MacBook, at least if you count the controversial touch bar on the MacBook Pro in the late 2010s.
paragraphs.cn: 触屏笔记本早已不是什么新鲜事，微软借Windows 8大力推动触控显示屏普及，更是广为人知。不过，史蒂夫·乔布斯当时反对触控显示屏，甚至早在2010年就斩钉截铁地表示：「触屏笔记本行不通。」虽然这位苹果之父不喜欢在笔记本上使用触屏，但苹果也并非首次为MacBook配备触控显示屏——至少，把2010年代末MacBook Pro上备受争议的触控栏算进去的话，确实如此。

paragraphs.en: However, it's clear that the RAM crisis has hit Apple as well. The new Touchscreen MacBook Pro costs an eye-watering $2,899 just to get in the door, which will get you the M5 Pro with a 15-core CPU and a 16-core GPU, along with 24GB of RAM and a 1TB SSD. The 16-inch model is even more expensive, and will set you back $3,399 to start, with a slightly more powerful M5 Pro configuration, along with the same 24GB RAM and 1TB SSD.
paragraphs.cn: 不过，内存危机显然也波及了苹果。新款触屏MacBook Pro光是入门价格就高达2,899美元(约合人民币2万元)，配备拥有15核CPU和16核GPU的M5 Pro，以及24GB内存和1TB SSD。16英寸机型则更贵，起售价为3,399美元(约合人民币2万元)，搭载性能稍强的M5 Pro，同样配备24GB内存和1TB SSD。

paragraphs.en: Of course, because it's a MacBook, you can absolutely max this thing out if you have the budget for it. Apple will let you spec the 16-inch model with an M5 Max, with an 18-core CPU and 40-core GPU, along with 128GB of RAM and a 16TB SSD for $14,399. Though, that kind of configuration would be absolutely overkill unless you're editing 4K footage every day, and constantly leave your external drive at home.
paragraphs.cn: 当然，毕竟是MacBook，只要预算充足，你完全可以把配置拉满。花上14,399美元(约合人民币10万元)，就能为16英寸机型选配拥有18核CPU和40核GPU的M5 Max，以及128GB内存和16TB SSD。不过，除非你每天都要剪辑4K素材，还总把外置硬盘落在家里，否则这样的配置实在是大材小用。

paragraphs.en: If you want to get your hands on the new MacBook Pro With PROLED XDR Display, you can preorder it today, and it will show up on store shelves on November 6.
paragraphs.cn: 如果你想入手这款配备PROLED XDR显示屏的新MacBook Pro，今天就可以预订，产品将于11月6日上架销售。
